hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the univariate template F(x)=V(x)*G0(x)*V(x). Substitute x=p and x=q to generate the two summands; the full expression is the sum of these two specializations.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are unary functions defined at p and q so that the products are well-formed.
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical terms are syntactically identical except for the replacement of p by q, so they are naturally instances of a single parameterized univariate object.
